subject: Re: RoleProof artifacts & SAML-SCIM sync timeline
messages:
From: Margaret Tan <margaret.tan@hcls-consulting.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finserv.com
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SSO evidence request: role mappings and SCIM logs

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this on. FinServ's audit team has asked for the following artifacts to close out the SIG and SOC 2 control substantiation for provisioning and access management:

- SAML assertion samples for IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows (anonymized)
- SCIM sync logs for the last 30 days showing create/update/delete events
- Role/entitlement mapping (CSV) showing app role -> Redwood role -> privilege level
- Least-privilege matrix for service accounts used by the onboarding pipeline

Can you confirm scope and estimate when we can deliver a first bundle? If helpful we can accept a redacted sample set first and follow up with full logs under an NDA/data-transfer procedure.

Thanks,
Margaret
Margaret Tan
Principal Consultant, HCLS Consulting

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Margaret Tan <margaret.tan@hcls-consulting.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SSO evidence request: role mappings and SCIM logs

Thanks Margaret — looping in Marcus and Jonas from the compliance team to scope access artifacts and pull the logs.

Quick answers / proposed scope:  
- We can provide anonymized SAML assertion samples (AuthnRequest, Assertion) for both IdP/SP flows.
- We'll extract SCIM sync deltas for the requested 30-day window; initial delivery will be a redacted subset (user ids replaced with hashed identifiers) and a follow-up package with a secure transfer if required.
- Role mapping CSV: we'll include current role definitions and a snapshot of active entitlements as of the first extraction date.
- Least-privilege matrix for service accounts: we'll export the internal spreadsheet and mark any secrets/keys out of scope.

Marcus / Jonas — can you confirm: 1) which SCIM sync dates we should capture (we propose 2025-03-12 -> 2025-04-11), 2) whether the SOC2 team needs full audit logs or a sampling approach, and 3) an internal owner for redaction before handoff?

Margaret — assuming the above, target to deliver a redacted bundle by Tue 2025-04-15, full transfer by Thu 2025-04-24 behind the secure upload. Does that align with the FinServ audit window?

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Margaret Tan <margaret.tan@hcls-consulting.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SSO evidence request: role mappings and SCIM logs

Evelyn — short answers and an artifact list.

1) SCIM window: we can extract 2025-03-12 00:00 UTC -> 2025-04-11 23:59 UTC; that captures two major sync cycles and the recent user provisioning incidents.

2) Audit scope: for SOC 2 summary review, FinServ has accepted a redacted sampling approach in prior engagements. We'll prepare:
   - scim_sync_excerpt.log (redacted; includes event type, timestamp, hashed_subject_id, delta fields)
   - role_mapping_sample.csv (cols: app_role, redwood_role, privilege_tier, last_modified_by)
   - least_privilege_matrix.xlsx (service account, scope, justification)

3) Internal owner for redaction: Jonas will perform the initial redaction pass and then handoff to Security for an automated scrub.

Attachments referenced: role_mapping_sample.csv; scim_sync_excerpt.log; least_privilege_matrix.xlsx

Timeline: redacted bundle by 2025-04-15 (EOD); secure transfer of full logs by 2025-04-24 pending NDA and secure bucket provisioning. I'll coordinate the extraction job; expect a short maintenance window (< 30 minutes) to snapshot logs.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Marcus — I ran a quick scan and have a two-step redaction approach:  

1) Scripted hash of PII (email, username, employee id) producing hashed_subject_id; preserve mapping in an internal vault for traceability.
2) Remove any OAuth tokens/refresh tokens and replace with token_id placeholders; strip stack traces.

I'll prepare the evidence_workback_schedule.xlsx and a short README (SAML-sample-readme.md) describing the anonymization procedure. Once we have signoff from Margaret I'll push redacted artifacts to the secureDrive link below.

Secure Drive (redacted bundle): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-roleproof-evidence
